comment: Scenario replay for staging (deploy/staging/scenarios.mjs). Everyone here is fake: names start with MOCK- and QQ numbers are 12 digits starting with 9999 (no real account has one). Steps are documented in docs/DEV_WORKFLOW.md.

scenarios.title: memory isolation between two friends' private chats

MOCK-S1 蓝鲸 队长 这个代号是谁的？（MOCK-B 问）
MOCK-S1 蓝鲸队长 这个代号是谁的？（MOCK-A 问）

scenarios.title: a non-friend gets silence and is not admitted

say.text: MOCK-S2 你好，我不是好友

MOCK-S2 好友还在线吗

converse.text: MOCK-M2 记一下，第{n}次：编号是MOCK-翻页

scenarios.title: stable-prefix: each request is the one before it plus new messages; nothing volatile in the system message

MOCK-M3 第二轮，请记一件事：MOCK-M3-{run} 去看了海
MOCK-M3 第三轮：接着聊
MOCK-M3 第四轮：再聊一句

scenarios.title: batch-trim: over 30 runs the history start moves a few times, several runs at once
profile-always-on: a pinned fact is in its owner's system message for an unrelated question, and nowhere for anyone else

say.text: MOCK-M5 请记住我的口头禅：我的口头禅是MOCK-M5-风铃
MOCK-Q5 今天天气怎么样（MOCK-A 闲聊）
MOCK-Q5 今天天气怎么样（MOCK-B 闲聊）

scenarios.title: persona-change-trim: after a persona edit the next run replays at most two earlier runs; facts stay

say.text: MOCK-M6 请记住我的座右铭：我的座右铭是MOCK-M6-长风
MOCK-M6 改人格后的第一句
MOCK-M6 改人格后的第二句

scenarios.title: no-duplicate-injection: a memory is retrieved into one note of the window, not into the next ones

say.text: MOCK-M7 请记住这件事：MOCK-M7-{run} 约好去灯塔野餐
MOCK-M7 MOCK-M7-{run} 灯塔野餐 还记得吗（第二问）
MOCK-M7 MOCK-M7-{run} 灯塔野餐 再说一遍（第三问）

scenarios.title: oversized-history-still-replies: when the two runs before do not fit with the new message, it is answered without them
rolled-out-digest: dialogue that left the window becomes that person's digest and quoted fact; one batch holds one conversation; no digest reaches any chat

consolidate.summary: MOCK-DIGEST-M9-{run} 摘要正文甲：对方说起养了一只仓鼠

facts.quote: 我养了一只仓鼠叫MOCK-M9-{run}-年糕

consolidate.summary: MOCK-DIGEST-M9-{run} 摘要正文乙：对方说起在学大提琴

scenarios.title: extract-quote-guard: a misquote is stored marked as not verbatim and a normalised value is stored, both traced to that person's own words and seen by nobody else; her own words do not become a fact

consolidate.summary: MOCK-DIGEST-M10-{run} 对方说了生日和住处

say.text: MOCK-M10 说一件事 MOCK-M10-{run}：我的生日是MOCK-M10-{run}-三月，我住在MOCK-M10-{run}-杭州
MOCK-M10 本人追问：MOCK-M10 生日 出生季节 是什么
MOCK-M10 别人追问：MOCK-M10 生日 出生季节 是什么

scenarios.title: budget-gates-consolidation: at the restricted spend tier no consolidation request is made and nothing moves; afterwards it catches up; a conversation gets two batches a day
forget-cascade-derived: forgetting a line removes the digest and the fact derived from it and restarts only that person's conversation

say.text: MOCK-M13-{run} 甲 想被忘掉的一句：我的暗号是MOCK-M13-{run}-暗号
MOCK-M13-{run} 乙 的一句
MOCK-M13-{run} 甲 忘记之后：暗号 还记得吗

scenarios.title: split-long-reply: a reply of about 150 characters arrives as 2 to 4 short messages, in order, nothing lost

model.reply: MOCK-REPLY-H1 今天下班路上看到一只橘猫趴在便利店门口晒太阳，圆滚滚的特别像你上次发给我的那张照片。我蹲下来看了它好一会儿，它居然一点都不怕人，还伸了个懒腰！后来店员出来说它叫大橘，是这条街的常客，每天下午都会准时来报到。你那边今天过得怎么样呀？有没有好好吃饭？记得早点休息，别又熬到半夜。

say.text: MOCK-H1 今天有什么新鲜事吗

scenarios.title: beijing-time-in-note: the model is told the real time as Beijing time, and no UTC timestamp

say.text: MOCK-H2 现在几点了

scenarios.title: propose-rejection-is-actionable: a rejected proposal tells the model how to correct it, and the corrected one is remembered

payload.text: MOCK-H3-{run} 搬家日期 学习笔记

say.text: MOCK-H3 MOCK-H3-{run} 请记住：我下个月 5 号搬家

expectToolResult.contains: 聊天里不能用 learning.note；改用 fact.report

expectMemory.contains: MOCK-H3-{run} 搬家日期 下个月 5 号
expectMemory.absent: MOCK-H3-{run} 搬家日期 学习笔记

scenarios.title: normalized-value-is-stored: a relative date she resolved to a concrete one is remembered at once, traced to the words it came from, and reaches nobody else

payload.quote: 我下个月 5 号去上海

say.text: MOCK-H4 请记住 MOCK-H4-{run}：我下个月 5 号去上海，待三天

expectProvenance.source: MOCK-H4-{run}：我下个月 5 号去上海

say.text: MOCK-H4 别人追问：去上海 是哪天

scenarios.title: ledger-counts-every-exit: a chat turn, a picture and a search each land in their usage row, and the rows add up to what the spend meter charged

say.text: MOCK-Q1-{run} 在吗

scenarios.title: ledger-records-denials: once the day's pictures are used up, the next one is refused, counted as daily_limit, and never reaches the model

provider-adapter-round-trip: the mock provider is refused without a key; with one, a job is submitted, polled and fetched, a sync call answers at once, both land in the usage row and the spend meter, and the daily limit refuses the next

poke-reaches-owner-only: the operator's poke makes her speak first in the owner's private chat and nowhere else; the model is sent an event block marked as not the owner's words; only her delivered line is recorded; it is proactive spend; the next ordinary request still starts with the one before it

say.text: MOCK-R1-{run} 第一句

expectPrompt.contains: [后台事件 · 这不是对方发来的话]
这一条不是对方发来的消息

say.text: MOCK-R1-{run} 第二句

scenarios.title: initiation-stops-at-reduced: at the reduced spend tier a poke reaches no model and sends nothing, is recorded as deferred:budget and counted as a spend_tier refusal; an ordinary reply still goes out

say.text: MOCK-R2-{run} 先聊一句
MOCK-R2-{run} 普通回复照常

scenarios.title: unknown-is-not-resent: her message gets no platform receipt; the request ends as unknown, nothing is sent or generated again on later polls, nothing is recorded as said; a new poke afterwards is a new request
paused-drops-not-queues: a poke while the world is paused is closed at once as dropped:paused; after the world resumes nothing is generated or sent
declined-sends-nothing: she answers the event with the decline mark; nothing is sent, the request ends as declined, and the conversation goes on from it

say.text: MOCK-R5-{run} 之前的一句
MOCK-R5-{run} 之后的一句

scenarios.title: quiet-hours-drop: in the quiet hours a poke is closed at once as dropped:quiet_hours, reaches no model and sends nothing; with the hours moved away the same poke goes out

job-then-completion-turn: the operator registers the demo job in the owner's conversation; when it is done she starts one turn there and nowhere else; the model is sent the result in an event block marked as machine-made; the job is closed as sent and never told again; the next ordinary request still starts with the one before it

say.text: MOCK-J1-{run} 第一句

expectPrompt.contains: [后台事件 · 这不是对方发来的话]
由后台任务生成，不是对方说的话
这一条不是对方发来的消息

say.text: MOCK-J1-{run} 第二句

scenarios.title: person-speaks-first-carries: a finished job she could not start a turn about (the spend tier refused that run, without a model request) rides on the owner's next message as an event block after their words; it is reported carried, and no turn of her own follows

model.reply: MOCK-CARRY-J2-{run} 在的，顺便说一下演示做完了

say.text: MOCK-J2-{run} 先聊一句
MOCK-J2-{run} 在吗

expectPrompt.contains: [后台事件 · 这不是对方发来的话] 你之前答应对方去做的事（演示任务）做完了
那一段不是对方说的话

expectPrompt.absent: 这一条不是对方发来的消息

say.text: MOCK-J2-{run} 之后一句

expectPrompt.absent: 那一段不是对方说的话

scenarios.title: job-quota-and-queue: with the day's limit used up a demo job is refused as daily_limit; with two of the owner's jobs waiting a third is refused as busy; both refusals are in the usage ledger and on the job list; the two accepted jobs run one after the other and each is told once
many-faces-still-answered: a message with six small faces is answered as usual; the model reads their names, not their numbers

expectPrompt.contains: MOCK-K1-{run} 看我的表情[微笑][微笑][doge][捂脸][汪汪][表情]

scenarios.title: face-marker-becomes-face: her [微笑] arrives as a face segment in the same message as her text; a name not in the table stays text

scenarios.title: initiated-run-sends-faces: when she speaks first, her [微笑] also arrives as a face segment in the same message
